jobs.company: Top Gun Bodyguard and Security Consulting
jobs.description:
Job Overview
Top Gun Security & Investigations is seeking highly qualified "ARMED" security officers for assignments throughout Galveston, Harris, Fort Bend and Brazoria Counties. Candidates must have the following:
Active Texas Department of Public Safety Private Security Level 3 license
Reliable transportation
Approved firearm and related security officer equipment
Candidates will undergo a through interview, background and drug screening process prior to hiring.
JOIN the Top Gun Team!!!!!!!!!!

Duties

  • Monitor areas using CCTV surveillance systems
  • Perform patrol operations on foot or by vehicle
  • Control access points by verifying identification, issuing visitor badges, and managing entry logs for employees, contractors, visitors, and vendors.
  • Conduct thorough inspections of personnel, packages, and premises to prevent theft, vandalism, or unauthorized entry.
  • Respond promptly to security alarms or incidents, coordinating with law enforcement or emergency responders as necessary.
  • Maintain detailed incident reports, shift logs, and security records to document all activities accurately.
  • Utilize surveillance equipment such as CCTV cameras effectively to monitor activity across multiple locations.
  • Assist in conflict management by de-escalating tense situations with professionalism and tact.
  • Support emergency preparedness drills and ensure compliance with safety regulations at all times.

Skills

  • Proven experience in security roles, law enforcement, military service or related fields demonstrating strong situational awareness.
  • Knowledge of Texas laws as they pertain to Texas Security Officers
  • Knowledge of CCTV systems, surveillance techniques, and loss prevention methods.
  • Skilled in the use of firearms, defensive tactics, and intermediate weapons
  • Strong communications skills
  • Ability to effectively communicate with the public during non emergency and emergency situations

Conditions of Employment

  • Must be able to stand, walk and sit for extended periods (excess of 10hrs)
  • Must be able to work in all weather conditions
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Must have reliable means of communication (employer utilizes this method for employees to clock in & out)
  • Must be able to remain on duty during critical situations
  • Must has a serviceable handgun (final determination will be that of the employer)
  • Must have all required equipment set forth by employer
  • Must have up to date ballistic vest when required (some assignments this is MANDATORY)
  • Must participate in all employer mandated training
  • Must maintain uniforms in a clean and serviceable manner
  • Must ensure all state issued license are current and renewed at least 30days prior to expiration

Pay: $18.00 - $19.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

  • Do you speak or are you fluent in a foreign language

Experience:

  • Security or Related : 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

  • Level 3 Guard Card or Active Level 3 License (Required)

Shift availability:

  • Day Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)
jobs.description:
Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)

Join Our Team – Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer Needed

Retail Property

Position: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security OfficerSchedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours Weekly

  • Saturday–Sunday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • Monday–Tuesday: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Wednesday–Thursday: Off
  • Friday: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Pay Rate: $15.50-$16.00 (Depending on experience)

United Protective Services is seeking a professional, dependable, and customer-focused Security Officer to provide exterior vehicle patrol coverage at a retail property.

This is an active patrol position requiring the officer to operate a company/client patrol vehicle, maintain a visible security presence, and regularly work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine vehicle patrols throughout the property, parking lots, and surrounding exterior areas.
  • Maintain a visible and proactive security presence to deter theft, vandalism, trespassing, and unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor parking areas, storefronts, exterior access points, and other designated areas.
  • Identify and report suspicious activity, safety hazards, property damage, and maintenance concerns.
  • Professionally interact with tenants, customers, vendors, employees, and Property Management.
  • Respond promptly to security concerns, disturbances, and incidents.
  • Complete accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs), incident reports, and patrol documentation.
  • Safely operate the assigned patrol vehicle and comply with all company and property driving requirements.

Qualifications

  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required.
  • Must reside within approximately 20 miles of ZIP Code 77024.
  • Scheduling flexibility is required, including the ability to assist with coverage outside the regular schedule when operationally necessary.
  • Previous security experience preferred.
  • Must be comfortable operating a patrol vehicle for extended periods.
  • Must be willing and able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Professional appearance, attitude, and demeanor.
  • Ability to remain alert, observant, and proactive throughout the shift.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.
  • Ability to complete written and electronic security reports accurately.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is dependable, flexible, observant, professional, and customer-service oriented. Candidates should be comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and maintaining situational awareness while conducting continuous exterior patrols.

Because this position involves vehicle patrol and exterior security duties, applicants must be comfortable spending a significant portion of their shift driving, entering and exiting the patrol vehicle, and working outdoors in the elements.

Why Join United Protective Services?

  • Full-time, 40-hour weekly schedule.
  • Consistent permanent assignment.
  • Company/client patrol vehicle provided while on duty.
  • Stable work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Support from an established security management team.

If you are dependable, flexible, professional, live within the required area, and are comfortable performing active exterior vehicle patrols, we encourage you to apply.

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.
